items.title: Darius Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 29, 2024
items.q: A supergraphic of Amy Winehouse on one of the industrial building walls

ctx.x: A supergraphic of Amy Winehouse on one of the industrial building walls, we lived right above the canal. And in Camden Town every night is party night so after ten years of that and setting up my group and professional network to the level it needed to be, we decided to live like grown-ups and move out of London. And we moved down to Rye, R-Y-E, because, in a way because that’s where Henry James lived.
No kidding. What an attraction. Yeah.
